title: Coordination-store boot rebuilds every historical canonical schema and spends tens of seconds reopening under parallel load
outcome: Opening a current coordination store avoids redundant canonical-schema construction while preserving exact schema/header validation, fail-closed corruption handling and atomic predecessor upgrades.

The 47.430950 s and 19.076371 s of loaded time inside ensure that these probes do not separate are explicitly recorded and tracked independently in w-626c09f584be.

The change removes redundant schema work without weakening exact current/predecessor schema validation, corruption refusal or concurrent-upgrade correctness; behavioral tests cover these contracts and the loaded restart path, with no retry, skipped tests or increased timeout.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
